candidates.name: Farigh-Brega Gas Pipeline
aka: Zueitina Field 103-Sirte Oil Line 36B Gas Pipeline
Intisar A/103 to Brega Gas Pipeline
candidates.sponsor: National Oil Corporation (NOC) / Zueitina Oil Company (original 2006 contractor: China Petroleum Engineering & Construction Corporation, CPECC)
candidates.from: Al-Faragh field (via Zueitina Oil Company Field 103/103A supply base, Sirte Basin)
candidates.to: Kilometre 91 Complex, connecting to Sirte Oil Company's Line 36B and the Brega coastal gas network

evidence.note: NOC inaugurates first phase (30 km segment) connecting Farigh field at the Zueitina axis/Field 103A to a 42-inch trunkline within the Sirte network, expected to deliver gas to Brega and the national grid by end of month; Farigh field operated by Waha Oil Company.

NOC Chairman Masoud Suleiman hails completion of 42-inch, 130 km pipeline from Zueitina Oil Company's Field 103 to Sirte Oil Company's Line 36B (connecting at Km 91 Complex); project halted pre-2011, now completed; carries ~150 mmcf/d from Al-Faragh field to compression stations feeding the coastal gas network for domestic and export supply.

NOC begins trial operation of 42-inch, 130 km (80 mile) pipeline connecting Intisar A/103 field to the Brega gas distribution network; project stalled ~16 years before this 2026 trial; recovers ~150 mmcf/d of previously flared gas.

Original construction history: Zueitina Oil Company (NOC subsidiary) issued letter of intent to CPECC to build a 215 km, 42-inch, 1,500 mmcf/d pipeline from Zueitina's 103A supply base (Sirte basin) to the Brega coastal pipeline, gas sourced from the Faregh field and Zueitina concession, for onward delivery to Mellitah/Greenstream or domestic power generation; formal award expected Feb 2006.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row names Zueitina Field 103/103A, Sirte Oil Line 36B, or the Km 91 Complex as endpoints for a 42-inch line at this length. The only roster entries sharing the 42-inch diameter and general Intisar/Brega corridor are P1856 (Intesar-Brega Gas Pipeline, Intesar Oil field->Mersa Brega, len=333.0, dia=42.00) and P1858/P6714 (Bu-Attifel-Intesar, different endpoints). P1856's length (333 km) is more than double this project's built/reported length (130 km, originally contracted at 215 km in 2006), and none of the shorter Sirte-network segments already on the roster (P1857 103D-103A len=41 dia=40; P1867 Attahaddy-km-91.5 len=40 dia=30,12; P1872 Km-91.5-Brega len=184 dia=36,16) match this pipeline's specific named endpoints (Zueitina Field 103/103A, Line 36B) or its 42-inch diameter and 130 km length. Given the distinct sponsor history (2006 CPECC contract, stalled pre-2011, phased 2026 completion) and mismatched specs versus every candidate PID, this looks like a pipeline GEM has not captured — though the consolidator should double check against P1856 given the diameter match and shared Intisar/Brega corridor.
